title: BAD. Didn't work directly out from box
text:
BAD. Didn't work directly out from box. Didn't work. I was looking forward to using this for holiday cooking. I bought it on sale, and was only able to buy one (seller limit) otherwise I would have gotten 2, and given one as a Christmas present. Good thing I could only get one, because the one I have does not work and it would have been embarrassing to give a bad gift.

I was trying to make a blended soup on a cold day. I was all ready for this step, so I got this out, plugged it in, press buttons, nothing. Changed to another outlet just to be sure, still nothing. Just nothing. All pointless. Looks and feels good in hand, but it is 100% useless.

product_metadata.title: Multi-Use Immersion Blender, Hand Blender with Powerful Copper Motor 800W, High Speed, Turbo Mode, 3 in 1 Handheld Blender Stick Stainless Steel Blades, Whisk, Beaker with Measuring Marks, and Chopper
features: Powerful Blender - The hand blender has a motor of 800 watts with four ultra forceful blades that grind the toughest meats, ice, and fruit for smoothies, patties, soups, and any other smooth concoction.
High Speed - The emulsion blender boasts 2 speed options so you are sure to get the exact consistency you desire. For an additional boost and maximum power, use the TURBO button.
3-in-1 - The stick blender easily detaches from the base for simple cleaning and attaching other tools. 2 add-on devices and a 20 oz. beaker are included.

Bonus Attachments - The portable blender includes a durable whisk for beating eggs or creaming whip and a chopper with a lid that acts as a mini food processor for crushing nuts, chocolates, or berries.

Ergonomic Design – The slim base of this stick mixer allows for a steady grip and blending right in a pot or storage container. The attachments are all dishwasher safe, but the handheld blender stick should never be put through the dishwasher or immersed in water.
